newsitem.title: USA: AAR to provide services to UNC unit.
newsitem.headline: AAR to provide services to UNC unit.

text.p: AAR Corp. said Monday it has a 10-year contract worth at least $40 million to provide inventory management and support services to UNC Industrial Power, a subsidiary of UNC Inc.
Under the agreement, AAR will supply and manage inventory required to support UNC's overhaul and refurbishment programmes on Solar Saturn and Solar Centaur industrial gas turbine engines.
AAR, based in Wood Dale, Ill., also bought part of UNC Industrial Power's existing parts inventory and secured the rights to sell the parts back to the company as well as third parties.
AAR provides aerospace and aviation products and services.
UNC, based in Annapolis, Md., is an aviation services company.
AAR's stock was unchanged at $25.50, while UNC edged up 12.5 cents to $13.25 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
